title: Poodle Puff
premise: A leaf blower hits a fluffy poodle. She becomes a perfect sphere and rolls happily down the street.
visual: Autumn sidewalk. A gardener with a leaf blower, jaw dropped. A white poodle puffed into a perfect fluffy ball, tiny legs and a delighted face poking out, rolling away through swirling leaves.
characterLean: Wind-gag cousin to the dry microburst ideas. Pure kid cutaway.

notes: She loves it. If she looks upset the gag fails.
